keyPhrases.text: This show is beautiful and moving on its own merits
bold of Kenny Leon to stage Our Town in this barebones way
the spoken words don't quite hold up as well
The characters are rather one dimensional
I couldn't stop thinking of him as Sheldon

reasoning: Mixed-positive review that praises the production's boldness, scenic design, and thematic impact while criticizing the script's weaknesses, character development, and Parsons' performance. The reviewer finds philosophical value in the experience despite significant reservations about the material and lead performance.
